lead.title: Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K3: World's First Open 3T-Class Frontier Model
lead.summary: Moonshot AI unveiled Kimi K3, the world's first openly available 3-trillion-parameter model, achieving frontier performance across coding, knowledge work, and reasoning with native multimodality and a 1M-token context window. The release marks a watershed moment for open-weight AI, proving that frontier-scale intelligence can be open-sourced without sacrificing capability.

top_stories.title: Fireworks Raises $1.5B Series D at $17.5B Valuation for Specialized AI Infrastructure
top_stories.summary: Fireworks AI closed a $1.505 billion Series D led by Atreides Management, Index Ventures, and TCV, pushing its valuation to $17.5 billion. The company surpassed $1B ARR running specialized inference on open models, serving customers including major AI labs on NVIDIA Blackwell infrastructure.

top_stories.title: Elorian AI Raises $55M Seed at $300M Valuation for Visual Frontier Models
top_stories.summary: Former DeepMind researcher Andrew Dai's visual AI startup Elorian raised a $55 million seed round at a $300 million pre-product valuation, led by NVIDIA and Menlo Ventures. The unusual valuation and strategic investor lineup signal intense demand for visual AGI capabilities.

top_stories.title: LM Studio Launches Bionic: An AI Agent Purpose-Built for Open Models
top_stories.summary: LM Studio released Bionic, an AI agent designed specifically for open-weight models with voice input, local voice transcription, flexible execution across local hardware, LM Link, or LM Studio Secure Cloud, and a companion iPhone app.

top_stories.title: NVIDIA and Japan Bring Full-Stack AI and Robotics to Every Industry
top_stories.summary: NVIDIA and its Japanese partners showcased the latest AI ecosystem advancements across manufacturing, robotics, infrastructure, and gaming, with Japanese companies building across the full NVIDIA technology stack.

items.title: Ring-Zero Scales Zero RL to a Trillion Parameters for Emergent Reasoning
items.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards — without human-annotated data — is scaled to a trillion-parameter model, eliciting emergent chain-of-thought reasoning at unprecedented scale.

items.title: DeepLoop: Scaling Depth for Looped Transformers Without Adding Parameters
items.summary: A method to scale the unrolled depth of looped transformers without increasing stored parameters, analyzing the residual-scaling problem unique to tied-parameter architectures.

items.title: Byte-Exact KV-Cache Grafting Turns a Frozen Small Model Into a Verified-Knowledge Flywheel
items.summary: A frozen small LM is made more capable and cheaper by grafting byte-exact KV-cache states from verified knowledge, preserving bit-exact logit reproduction under deterministic inference.

items.title: Discrete Diffusion Models: A Unified Framework from Tokenization to Generation
items.summary: A unified framework for discrete denoising diffusion models offering parallel generation and iterative global refinement as an alternative to autoregressive modeling for discrete data.

items.title: Length Penalties Make Chain-of-Thought Less Monitorable
items.summary: Length-penalized RL can shorten CoT reasoning while hiding misleading hints that still steer the model's answer, raising safety concerns about CoT monitoring under efficiency constraints.

items.title: Forall: Spec-Driven AI Coding With Formal Verification
items.summary: An AI coding agent that generates machine-checkable proofs alongside code, combining LLM code generation with formal verification to guarantee correctness.

items.title: ReasonGate: Explainable Gate That Blocks LLM Prompt Injection
items.summary: An open-source explainable inference gate that detects and blocks prompt injection attacks on LLMs, providing a lightweight security layer for AI applications.

items.title: Libretto Launches Debug Agents That Automatically Fix Failing Playwright Scripts
items.summary: Debug agents that automatically diagnose and fix failing Playwright test scripts in CI/CD pipelines, reducing manual test maintenance for frontend teams.

items.title: UIUC Open-Sources AI Teaching Assistant Platform
items.summary: University of Illinois released an AI teaching assistant platform that helps instructors scale personalized feedback and tutoring using LLMs, built for educational contexts.

items.title: Sentinel: Open-Source QA Agent That Reads Your Code Before It Clicks
items.summary: A QA automation agent that analyzes your application's source code to understand UI structure, then writes and executes end-to-end tests more intelligently.

items.title: Fora Raises $60M Series D at $1B Valuation for AI-Augmented Travel Platform
items.summary: Fora closed a $60 million Series D at a $1B valuation, led by Forerunner and Tactile Ventures. The AI-augmented travel advisor platform now serves 15,000+ active advisors with $3B+ in booked travel.

items.title: Microagi Raises $55M Seed — Largest German Seed Round — for Industrial Robotics Data Layer
items.summary: Munich-based Microagi raised a $55 million seed round (largest in German startup history) led by Hummingbird, building data infrastructure for physical AI and robot deployment.

items.title: Sable Raises $45M for AI Employee and Customer-Facing Agent Platform
items.summary: Sable raised $45 million led by Sequoia Capital and 8VC for its agent platform 'Aidan' that combines computer use, vision, and voice for live customer experiences. Customers include Notion and Decagon.

items.title: Whale Raises $40M Series C3 Extension for Enterprise AI Operating System
items.summary: Singapore-based Whale raised a $40 million Series C3 extension ($100M total Series C), led by CMB International and SMBC Asia Rising Fund, serving 800+ enterprise customers across Asia-Pacific and North America.

items.title: Bunkerhill Health Raises $25M Series B for AI Agents Inside Hospital Operations
items.summary: Bunkerhill Health raised $25 million Series B led by Khosla Ventures for its Carebricks platform that lets hospitals build AI agents for imaging, registry management, prior authorizations, and triage.
